newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates rise across the board.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates rise across the board.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose across the board on Thursday after the Central Bank started offering six-month term reverse repos at a higher-than-market rate of 10.125 percent, traders said.
"This meant interest rates were on the way up. So, everybody responded accordingly," a foreign bank dealer said.
"But it's not going to be as high as everyone thinks. The increase will just be little bit," the dealer said, noting that banks are still awash with liquidity.
In recent weeks, the 91-day and 182-day Treasury bill rates have dipped to single-digit levels, the first time since September 1995 and October 1994, respectively.
